correctness.rationale: Exact bisector containment and strict-convexity vertex reduction identify all four candidates. The packaged rational checker exhausts 792 five-hyperplane subsets, recovers 41 vertices, proves no closer sites in mathematically sufficient displacement boxes, finds six affinely independent equidistant sites for each candidate, and checks symmetry orbit sizes. Analytic site-hole incidence gives 192 periodic holes and nonoverlapping Delaunay determinant volumes yield 4/5. The finite certificate and global lifting conditions are explicitly included.

value.rationale: Classifies an intrinsic but previously not explicitly computed feature of a record five-dimensional periodic covering: every worst hole, all symmetry multiplicities, six-site Delaunay simplices, and the exact fraction 4/5 of space tiled by largest-circumradius cells. Requiring exact verification of other chamber maxima and cross-site orbit accounting makes the finding a meaningful structural classification, not a routine corollary of the known numerical covering radius.
